from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP

# PRECISE SPEC: round half-UP to exactly 2 decimal places, return a float.
def round_price(amount):
    # Use the shortest repr of the float (str) so 1.005 is treated as 1.005,
    # not its binary approximation 1.00499999...
    d = Decimal(str(amount))
    return float(d.quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))

print(round_price(2.675), round_price(1.005), round_price(0.125), round_price(10.0))
